title: senecio integerrimus var. major
intro: Senecio integerrimus var. major, commonly known as tall golden ragwort or tall whole-leaf ragwort, is a perennial plant in the daisy family, known for its tall stature and bright yellow flowers. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Senecio integerrimus var. major include stimulating the immune system and acting as a natural diuretic, which can help in treating urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
